description: Defines an abstract class SimplePage that implements the Page interface, providing basic page structure with title and content. It includes methods for initializing, retrieving, and generating page content.

classes.name: SimplePage
classes.description: An abstract class representing a simple page with title and content, providing basic methods for initialization and content retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the page with a title and content.

methods.name: getPureContent
methods.description: Returns the raw content of the page.

methods.name: initializePage
methods.description: Initializes the page's title and content.

methods.name: generatePage
methods.description: Generates and returns the page content.
